name: Prime Factorization Encoding
description: Replaced the per-edge constraint with a global product equation over all channels: $\prod (x_u + x_v) = 3^m$. Because $x_i \in \{1, 2\}$, the sum $x_u+x_v \in \{2, 3, 4\}$. By the uniqueness of prime factorization, the only way a product of $m$ such terms can equal exactly $3^m$ is if every single term is exactly 3. This mathematically forces $x_u \neq x_v$ for every channel. This requires models to deduce the local bipartite constraint from a global property, defeating simple pattern matching of per-edge rules, while keeping the prose completely natural and free of contrived gadgets.
